say:1:1841113001:1.text: It's been so long since I danced. I'm getting rusty.
say:1:1841113001:1.source_cn: 好久没有跳舞，感觉舞步都有些生疏了。
say:1:1841113001:1.male: It's been so long since I danced. I'm getting rusty.
say:1:1841113001:1.female: It's been so long since I danced. I'm getting rusty.

say:2:1841113002:1.text: At least I didn't miss a step just now. If Thane had noticed, he'd be glaring at me again.
say:2:1841113002:1.source_cn: 还好刚刚没有跳错。要不然被瑟恩发现的话，他又要瞪我了。

say:4:1841113003:1.text: He is... House Rayne may be based on the frontier, but we still have to attend noble banquets now and then. I can hardly show up without knowing how to dance.
say:4:1841113003:1.source_cn: 是啊……虽然瑞恩家族身处边境，但难免要出席一些贵族晚宴...
say:4:1841113003:1.male: He is... House Rayne may be based on the frontier, but we still have to attend noble banquets now and then. I can hardly show up without knowing how to dance.

say:5:1841113004:1.text: And it doesn't stop there. I'm expected to know etiquette, poetry, music...
say:5:1841113004:1.source_cn: 除此之外，还要懂一些礼仪、诗歌、音乐……
say:5:1841113004:1.male: And it doesn't stop there. I'm expected to know etiquette, poetry, music...
say:5:1841113004:1.female: And it doesn't stop there. I'm expected to know etiquette, poetry, music...

say:6:1841113005:1.text: Basically, I have to learn a little of everything. It's such a pain.
say:6:1841113005:1.source_cn: 总之我要学很多东西，很麻烦。
say:6:1841113005:1.male: Basically, I have to learn a little of everything. It's such a pain.

say:8:1841113006:1.text: It's not that I hate any of it. I just feel that I shouldn't be spending my time on dancing and poetry while our soldiers are risking their lives at the front.
say:8:1841113006:1.source_cn: 其实，我没有不喜欢这些。我只是觉得，当将士们在前线冲锋...
say:8:1841113006:1.male: It's not that I hate any of it. I just feel that I shouldn't be spending my time on dancing and poetry while our soldiers are risking their lives at the front.

say:9:1841113007:1.text: If I spent those hours gathering intelligence and planning our next move, perhaps a few more soldiers would come home alive—
say:9:1841113007:1.source_cn: 如果把这些时间拿去探明敌情、指定策略，或许前线的将士就...
say:9:1841113007:1.male: If I spent those hours gathering intelligence and planning our next move, perhaps a few more soldiers would come home alive—
say:9:1841113007:1.female: If I spent those hours gathering intelligence and planning our next move, perhaps a few more soldiers would come home alive—

say:13:1841113010:1.text: I don't make you study etiquette for the sake of appearances. One day, House Rayne and Ashvale County may depend on the allies you can win in a banquet hall.
say:13:1841113010:1.source_cn: 我要求你学习贵族礼节，同样是为了保护瑞恩家族和灰影郡。

say:14:1841113011:1.text: We can't count on winning this war, or even on the balance holding forever. If Bantus sends more troops, Ashvale County could find itself badly outnumbered.
say:14:1841113011:1.source_cn: 我们无法保证灰影郡的战事能赢得胜利，或是永远维持现状。...

say:15:1841113012:1.text: If that happens, we'll have to call on the other houses for help.
say:15:1841113012:1.source_cn: 到了那时候，我们只能向其他贵族求援。

say:16:1841113013:1.text: They won't stand behind House Rayne unless they trust and respect us.
say:16:1841113013:1.source_cn: 想要他们的支援，瑞恩家族就必须获得他们的认同和尊重。

say:17:1841113014:1.text: And with nobles, the surest way to earn that is to be seen as one of their own.
say:17:1841113014:1.source_cn: 而贵族阶级里，最简单也最紧密的认同就是你们的贵族身份。

say:18:1841113015:1.text: ... I know. You've told me a hundred times.
say:18:1841113015:1.source_cn: ……我知道，这些话你说过很多次。

say:19:1841113016:1.text: And I know you're right. That's why I've kept up with the lessons.
say:19:1841113016:1.source_cn: 我承认，你说的话有道理，所以我一直在学习贵族礼节。

say:20:1841113017:1.text: But the war still gets most of my time. I'm the head of House Rayne. My first duty is to bring our soldiers home alive!
say:20:1841113017:1.source_cn: 但我会把更多时间分给战事。将士们的安全，才是瑞恩家主最...
